structural_change: HBM-SU3 10-17 cxport SPLIT (coordinator 0dc: hub of 13.2k pin bits on 264.6 um): the quarter hub becomes 4 delivery leaves beside the pgslices, one inject-gather leaf and one RED_CARRY/SFU-operand leaf beside sucore; same epoch counters, slots and edges (lockstep vs the hub PASS QID 2 and QID 0/B39, split-only mutants 1-4 FAIL); the delivery calendar rule (lane j -> slice j) now FAULTs if broken. Every 3:4 crossing is MUX-ONLY (decode before the slot on the writer side; STA times stream->serial at the 1-quantum pair, 278 ps): the hub-equivalent dl gate showed -266 ps (dw_d after the slot decode) and rc -277 ps (64:1 SFU lane select); the SFU operand is registered whole and lane-selected on the next serial edge (compiler: SFU-source reducer command at E+1). HBM-SU6 10-17 (gate WARNs on bf7c343cb / 7bde7baff): dl phase slots are the pin registers (raw lane + 4 kept copies of the lane code; half/valid zeroing after the slot mux, same edges); ij inject select registered one-hot (64 b, 256 loads each; no runtime part-select), reset only on valid bits, aperture partials finished serial-side; rc red_sel decoded one-hot (33 loads/bit), carry reset from 2 kept regional copies, pend payload unreset. Leaf rc: W COLL/SFU stream side (1,048 b, 4.9/um), E sucore serial side (373 b), clocks at the N centre.
